purpose: Help visitors build a conflict-free personal itinerary for a regional botany festival while preserving enough editorial context to choose sessions confidently.

screens.purpose: Introduce the regional event, expose day filters, and present the browsable session program.
Show the selected session's time, venue, guide, habitat context, description, and plan action.
Show an empty invitation or the visitor's ordered, removable, saved session selections.
Explain an overlap without mutating the plan and provide explicit replace or cancel recovery.

constraints: Strict mode is required by the public-benchmark trigger.
The mouse is an embedded field guide only in editorial and empty-plan states, never persistent navigation chrome.
A clashing add must preserve the existing plan until the visitor explicitly confirms replacement.
Conflict resolution must be reversible by cancellation and must return focus to the initiating control.
Program filters, session inspection, planning, conflict recovery, and saved feedback must work with keyboard and pointer input.
Status changes must be announced without relying on color, motion, or the character.
Reduced-motion preferences must remove nonessential movement while preserving state clarity.
The narrow layout must remain usable at 390 pixels without horizontal scrolling.
Accepted source and standalone output must remain byte-identical and supported by reviewable screenshots and comparison evidence.
